ideas.pitch: An automated reconnaissance tool tailored for CTF web and OSINT categories that rapidly parses digital footprints and social graphs.
ideas.title: OSINT-Automator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core domains of Slay CTF by automating repetitive OSINT tracking phases, giving a competitive edge on the jeopardy board.

ideas.pitch: A specialized defense-in-depth proxy designed to catch and neutralize prompt injection attempts in LLM-based CTF challenges.
ideas.title: PromptShield-CTF
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages advanced defense-in-depth patterns to solve modern security challenges, scoring well with technical security judges.

ideas.pitch: A Python-based repository and dependency security analyzer that flags hidden API keys, SQLi vectors, and hardcoded secrets.
ideas.title: SecureAudit-CLI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on genuine hard engineering in static code analysis, mirroring winning report-generation security tooling.

ideas.pitch: An interactive crypto-analysis dashboard equipped with frequency analysis, custom substitution cracking, and automated cipher identification.
ideas.title: CipherForge
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the cryptography and analytical thinking tracks of the CTF directly with a polished, high-performance UI.

ideas.pitch: A purposely vulnerable web application framework complete with built-in exploit verification scripts for educational CTF training.
ideas.title: VulnWeb-Lab
ideas.why_it_could_win: Creates deep technical value for both offensive security players and event organizers seeking training utilities.
